name: Firewheel Town Center
summary: Firewheel Town Center is Garland's premier open-air lifestyle destination featuring brand-name department stores, boutiques, diverse dining options, and a cinema. This Simon-managed property serves as a regional shopping and entertainment hub for northeast Dallas suburbs.
demographics: Firewheel Town Center attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals from the Garland and northeast Dallas suburbs. The primary trade area consists of households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+, with a strong representation of families with children and millennials aged 25-45. Shoppers are drawn to the center's combination of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues, with typical visits combining multiple activities such as shopping, dining, and movies. The center serves as a regional destination for the growing Garland area, appealing to value-conscious yet brand-aware consumers seeking a convenient outdoor shopping experience.
description: Firewheel Town Center stands as Garland's premier open-air shopping destination, offering a dynamic blend of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences. Developed and managed by Simon Property Group, this lifestyle center has become a cornerstone of the northeast Dallas retail landscape since its opening. The center features an impressive mix of brand-name department stores and boutique retailers, creating a diverse shopping environment that caters to a wide range of tastes and budgets. Beyond shopping, Firewheel Town Center has established itself as a community gathering place with its variety of eateries ranging from casual dining to quick-service options, complemented by a modern cinema for entertainment. The open-air design creates an inviting atmosphere where visitors can enjoy the Texas weather while strolling between stores, making it a popular destination for both everyday shopping needs and special occasions.
